subject: Technical demo: follow-up and calendar sync for docs quickstart sign-up

From: Samir Kapoor <samir@buildforge.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Docs quickstart signup — request for a technical demo

Hi Evelyn,

I signed up via the docs quickstart this morning and poked around the sandbox. We're evaluating Redwood for an internal knowledge retrieval project at BuildForge and would like a short technical demo focused on model routing, embeddings, and cost controls. My expectations: 30–45 minutes, live Q&A with an engineer.

A few constraints: my team is in PST (San Francisco) but I will be traveling the morning of 7/29 (Pacific → ET) so mornings are preferable for us. Can your team propose 2 options for 30-min slots this week or early next week?

Company: BuildForge
Role: Backend engineering lead
Team size: 3 (proto/ML infra)

Thanks — happy to share a brief doc about our ingestion patterns if that helps.

—Samir
Samir Kapoor
BuildForge
samir@buildforge.com

Hi Samir — thanks for signing up and for the details. Very excited to walk through routing and embeddings with you.

Quick availability from our side this week (all times PST):
- Wed 7/28 2:00–2:30 PM
- Thu 7/29 9:00–9:30 AM
- Fri 7/30 11:00–11:30 AM

If none of those work, here's a 30-min booking link to pick a slot directly: https://cal.example.com/evelyn/30

I've looped in Vivek (ML infra) who will join for live Q&A. I'll attach a short demo guide and the intake screenshot you can review before the call.

Proposed agenda (30 mins):
1) 5m — intro & goals
2) 10m — architecture: routing, caching, and quantization profiles
3) 10m — hands-on: embeddings + affinity examples from your ingestion notes (if shared)
4) 5m — next steps / followups (trial, Dedicated options)

If you can confirm a slot I will send a Zoom invite.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
SDR, Redwood Inference
